questions.answer: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) is a strategic framework for making sure your brand appears in AI-generated search results and recommendations. It involves optimizing your digital footprint so AI systems like ChatGPT, Google's Search Generative Experience, and Perplexity recognize your brand as authoritative and trustworthy enough to cite [6]. Per this site, GEO is broader and longer term than AEO, focusing on making a brand a recognized entity that AI systems mention by name [5]. You can read more on the [FAQ page](/faq/).

questions.answer: Per this site's FAQ, SEO is a long-term investment, and timelines depend on your starting point, competition, and goals. Technical fixes and quick wins can show impact within weeks, meaningful organic traffic growth typically appears between three and six months, and substantial, compounding results are often visible at six to twelve months [1]. Visibility in AI systems (AEO and GEO) can shift faster, since those platforms update their knowledge bases more often [1]. For a timeline specific to your situation, you can reach out via the [contact page](/contact/).
